verses: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
إِلَّا بَلَٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

leads.title: Michael arises, the resurrection, and the sealed book ↔ The jinn hear the recitation
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Your dead shall live, their corpses rise; dwellers in the dust shall awake and sing (weight 4.9). Pair score 4.9.

Only in Michael arises, the resurrection, and the sealed book: Two figures stand on either bank of the river, with a linen-clad figure above the waters; Secret reckonings: 1,290 days from the abolition of the daily offering, and blessed is he who waits for 1,335 days; Many shall run to and fro and knowledge shall increase; The seer is told he will rest and rise to his allotted portion at the end of days; A time of trouble such as never was since nations existed; The wise shine like the brightness of the firmament and those who turn many to righteousness like the stars forever; On judgment day each receives a book of his deeds spread open, leaving nothing small or great unrecorded [divergence between the texts]; God raises his hand to heaven and swears: as I live forever; Into how many groups humankind is sorted at the end [divergence between the texts]; A heavenly being or the seer asks 'Until when (ad matai)?' the desolation will last; The resurrected cry 'Woe to us, who has raised us from our sleeping place (marqad)?'; Persecution lasts 'a time, times and half a time' (three and a half periods); and 8 more.

Only in The jinn hear the recitation: Men used to seek refuge with male jinn, who only increased them in burden; Among the jinn are the righteous and the unjust, believers (muslimun) and deviators (qasitun), of different ways; A band of jinn overhears the recitation of scripture, believes and reports it to their kind; The places of prostration (al-masajid) belong to God; call on no one beside him; God alone knows the unseen and discloses it only to a messenger he approves, sending watchers before and behind him; God commands his angels to guard the faithful and bear him on their palms lest he strike his foot on a stone; God has taken neither consort (sahiba) nor child; Men used to seek refuge with male jinn, who only increased them in burden [contrast between the texts]; Jinn or devils who used to sit listening at heaven's gates now find it full of stern guards and shooting stars (shuhub) lying in wait; God has counted everything by number and recorded it in a book; On that day man asks 'where to flee?' but there is no refuge; the destination is with God; Seek forgiveness and repent, and God will send the sky down on you in abundant rain; and 1 more.

Only in Song of the strong city; your dead shall live: Other lords ruled us; they are dead, they will not live; shades (rephaim) will not rise; their memory is wiped out; God's dew is a 'dew of lights' (tal orot) and the earth will give birth to the shades (rephaim); The earth will disclose the blood shed on it and no longer cover its slain; 'Go, my people, enter your chambers and shut the doors behind you; hide a little moment until the wrath passes'; We were pregnant, we writhed, but gave birth only to wind; we brought no salvation to the earth; God keeps the steadfast mind in perfect peace (shalom shalom) because it trusts in him; 'My soul yearns for you in the night; my spirit within me seeks you at dawn'; 'We have a strong city... Open the gates that the righteous nation that keeps faith may enter'; In Yah YHWH is an everlasting rock (tsur olamim); What the dead say when they wake from the dust [divergence between the texts]; On God's day all that is lofty (cedars of Lebanon, oaks of Bashan, towers, ships of Tarshish) is brought low and God alone exalted; The Gardens of Eden have their gates opened for the righteous; and 7 more.

leads.title: Psalm 91, shelter of the Most High; the noonday demon; angels bear you up ↔ The jinn hear the recitation
leads.summary: 2 correspondences read side by side: 1 opposite ruling, 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: Men used to seek refuge with male jinn, who only increased them in burden [contrast between the texts] (weight 6.7); God commands his angels to guard the faithful and bear him on their palms lest he strike his foot on a stone (weight 6.7). Pair score 13.4.

Only in Psalm 91, shelter of the Most High; the noonday demon; angels bear you up: One who dwells in the shelter of Elyon lodges in the shadow of Shaddai; God delivers from the snare of the fowler; A thousand fall at your side, ten thousand at your right, but it does not come near you; The protected one treads on lion and cobra, young lion and dragon (tannin); Protection from the terror of the night, the arrow by day, the pestilence (dever) stalking in darkness and Qeteb that ravages at noon; Psalm used as protection against demons and harm (later amulet and 'song of plagues'); Petitioner takes refuge in the shadow of God's wings; Resheph and Qeteb (plague deities/demons) sent as God's arrows; A psalm quotes a first-person oracle of God; God called rock, fortress, refuge, stronghold or tower of strength.

Only in The jinn hear the recitation: Men used to seek refuge with male jinn, who only increased them in burden; Among the jinn are the righteous and the unjust, believers (muslimun) and deviators (qasitun), of different ways; A band of jinn overhears the recitation of scripture, believes and reports it to their kind; The places of prostration (al-masajid) belong to God; call on no one beside him; God alone knows the unseen and discloses it only to a messenger he approves, sending watchers before and behind him; God has taken neither consort (sahiba) nor child; Jinn or devils who used to sit listening at heaven's gates now find it full of stern guards and shooting stars (shuhub) lying in wait; God has counted everything by number and recorded it in a book; On that day man asks 'where to flee?' but there is no refuge; the destination is with God; Seek forgiveness and repent, and God will send the sky down on you in abundant rain; Knowledge of the Hour is with God alone; it will come suddenly; Your dead shall live, their corpses rise; dwellers in the dust shall awake and sing.
